subject: *: extract column into map in the constant propagation (#64121)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for column-extraction refactor in constant propagation and pooled map reuse in PlanBuilder. Change switches per-condition column extraction from sorted slices to a reused `map[UniqueID]*Column` (from a `sync.Pool`) and updates `PlanBuilder.addColumnsWithVirtualExprs` to reuse the same pooled map. No Blocker/High correctness/semantics, session/transaction, concurrency, or compatibility issues found in the touched planner/expression paths; later history on upstream/master was checked for follow-up fixes relevant to these hunks and none were required to address a Blocker/High issue from this commit.
